# DecodeHer

> DecodeHer (Instagram: @thedecodeher) makes short, honest videos and guides that help men read texting and dating situations clearly, without manipulation.

## Product
- [Decode Her: The Texting Playbook](https://decodeher.pages.dev/): a 73-page PDF for men, US$17 (launch price US$9 for the first 100 copies). 25 real texting situations (dry texting, slow replies, left on read, "we'll see", cancelled dates, hot and cold, mixed signals, "what are we?" and more). For each: what she sent, what it usually means, the exact reply to send, the reply to never send, and the next move. Also 12 messages never to send, 30 conversation starters and a cheat sheet. Made for reading on a phone. Instant download after a secure checkout by Polar. 30-day refund.
- [Decode Her: The Complete Pack](https://decodeher.pages.dev/#get): US$27 (launch price US$19 for the first 100 copies). The playbook plus "Her Signals", a 29-page field guide to 20 things she does in person and on dates, and "The Reply Bank": 40 ready replies and 30 openers, as a PDF and a plain note for a phone Notes app.

## Approach
- Honest communication only: no jealousy games, no silence used as punishment, no lines designed to make anyone feel small.
- General communication and dating advice, not therapy or professional advice.
